name: dsh-plugin-office-markdown
description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle plugin: auto-convert workspace Office / PDF files to Markdown with Microsoft MarkItDown before the model reads them, writing the result next to the source file so only the .md path enters context. Ships a settings page that inspects local Python environments and can install/uninstall MarkItDown on request. Removing the bundle also removes the environment it recorded. Leaves no temp files, no registry and no cache metadata behind.
